safety_findings: Original data loader and prediction evaluator can access test outputs; original evaluation entrypoint is not approved for runtime use.
Safe experimental adapter must accept only train pairs and test inputs, never task identifiers or test outputs, and must reset task_token_embed.weight per task.
Separate process alone does not prove filesystem isolation; scorer answers must be inaccessible in the inference environment.
torch.load requires weights_only=True, model source and weights must be pinned, and only expected missing key is the newly initialized task token.
Reported pretraining provenance does not establish absence of overlap with this ARC2 evaluation or holdout.
torch/timm runtime, forward pass, CPU/GPU cost and holdout performance are NOT_RUN; assets are not an adopted solver.
provenance_note: The data and partial isolated Python environment remain outside Git; do not publish model weights or HDS assets.
